simple.meaning: בִּלְגַה (Bilgah) is a Hebrew word meaning “Bilgah , the name of two Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בִּלְגַה (H1083) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 24:14, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בִּלְגַה (H1083) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בִּלְגַה (H1083) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בִּלְגַה (Bilgah) / H1083 is traced through 1 Chronicles 24:14, Nehemiah 12:5, Nehemiah 12:18 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
